type.quote: the state board of nursing as established in chapter 14, title 54, Idaho Code

degree_required.value: Approved nursing education program (practical, registered, or advanced practice)
degree_required.quote: Have successfully completed the basic curriculum of an approved registered nursing education program or its equivalent

accrediting_body.value: Board of Nursing (approves nursing education programs)
accrediting_body.quote: To establish standards, criteria, and requirements for curricula for nursing education programs and to evaluate, survey, review and approve nursing education programs

exams.notes: Or endorsement from another state/territory/foreign country

exams.name: NCLEX-RN (registered nursing examination)

exams.quote: Pass an examination adopted and used by the board to measure knowledge and judgment essential for the safe practice of registered nursing

exams.notes: Qualifying examination recognized by the board plus current national certification
exams.quote: Have passed a qualifying examination recognized by the board and have current certification from a national organization recognized by the board

interval_years.quote: No license shall be valid unless renewed each and every two (2) years on the renewal dates fixed by the board.

required.quote: Certified nurse-midwives, clinical nurse specialists, certified registered nurse anesthetists and certified nurse practitioners desiring license renewal must provide proof, satisfactory to the board, of the applicant's competence to practice by documenting completion of a peer review process.

period_years.quote: No license shall be valid unless renewed each and every two (2) years on the renewal dates fixed by the board.

available.quote: Have a professional or registered nurse license in good standing, without restriction or limitation, issued upon successful similar examination, approved by the board, conducted in another state, territory or foreign country

requirements.value: License in good standing, without restriction or limitation, from another state, territory, or foreign country; must meet established board requirements
requirements.quote: Have a professional or registered nurse license in good standing, without restriction or limitation, issued by another state, territory or foreign country and meet established board requirements

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice nursing or offer to practice nursing unless that person is duly licensed pursuant to this chapter.

credential_type.quote: To license qualified persons for practice of nursing in Idaho; to renew licenses; to limit, restrict, amend, deny, suspend or revoke licenses

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice nursing or offer to practice nursing unless that person is duly licensed pursuant to this chapter.

title_protection.quote: Only a person who holds a valid and current license to practice registered nursing in this state or a party state pursuant to sections 54-1408 and 54-1418, Idaho Code, may use the title "nurse," "registered nurse," "graduate nurse" or "professional nurse" or the abbreviation "RN"

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice nursing or offer to practice nursing unless that person is duly licensed pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made a false, fraudulent, or forged statement in procuring or attempting to procure a nursing license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Made, or caused to be made, a false, fraudulent or forged statement or representation in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced nursing under a false or assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practiced nursing under a false or assumed name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of or entered a guilty plea for a crime deemed relevant under Idaho Code
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is convicted of or enters a guilty plea for a crime deemed relevant in accordance with section 67-9411(1), Idaho Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Grossly negligent or reckless in performing nursing functions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is or has been grossly negligent or reckless in performing nursing functions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitually uses alcoholic beverages or drugs as defined by rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitually uses alcoholic beverages or drugs as defined by rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physically or mentally unfit to practice nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is physically or mentally unfit to practice nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violates the provisions of the nursing practice act or board rules and standards of conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violates the provisions of this chapter or rules and standards of conduct and practice as may be adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engages in conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or endanger patients or the public, including failure to report criminal conduct by a licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Otherwise engages in conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud or endanger patients or the public, which includes, but is not limited to, failing or refusing to report criminal conduct or other conduct by a licensee that endangers patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has been disciplined by a nursing regulatory authority in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been disciplined by a nursing regulatory authority in any jurisdiction. A certified copy of the order entered by the jurisdiction shall be prima facie evidence of such discipline

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the terms of any board order, negotiated settlement, or probationary agreement, or to pay fines or costs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the terms of any board order, negotiated settlement or probationary agreement of the board or to pay fines or costs assessed in a prior disciplinary proceeding

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual or sexually exploitative conduct with a patient or former patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in conduct with a patient that is sexual, sexually exploitative, sexually demeaning or may reasonably be interpreted as sexual, sexually exploitative or sexually demeaning

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the requirements of the abortion complications reporting act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of the abortion complications reporting act, chapter 95, title 39, Idaho Code.

definition_quote.value: The performance by licensed practical nurses, registered nurses and advanced practice registered nurses of acts and services that require formal nursing education and specialized knowledge, judgment and skill, which acts and services assist individuals, groups, communities and populations in order to promote, maintain or restore optimal health and well-being throughout the life process.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of nursing" means the performance by licensed practical nurses, registered nurses and advanced practice registered nurses of acts and services that require formal nursing education and specialized knowledge, judgment and skill, which acts and services assist individuals, groups, communities and populations in order to promote, maintain or restore optimal health and well-being throughout the life process.

value: assessing health status of individuals and groups
identifying health care problems amenable to nursing intervention
establishing goals to meet identified health care needs
implementing the strategy of care including administering medications and treatments
authorizing nursing interventions that may be performed by others
maintaining safe and effective nursing care
teaching the theory and practice of nursing
methods_authorized.quote: Assessing the health status of individuals and groups of individuals; Identifying health care problems that are amenable to nursing intervention; Establishing goals to meet identified health care needs; Planning a strategy of care; Prescribing nursing interventions to implement the strategy of care; Implementing the strategy of care, including administering medications and treatments as prescribed by those health care providers authorized to prescribe medication

drug_authority.value: Advanced practice registered nurses are authorized to prescribe, administer, and dispense therapeutic pharmacologic agents as defined by board rules
drug_authority.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse is authorized to perform advanced nursing practice, which may include the prescribing, administering and dispensing of therapeutic pharmacologic agents, as defined by board rules.

license_tiers.quote: Advanced practice registered nurses shall include the following four (4) roles: certified nurse-midwife; clinical nurse specialist; certified nurse practitioner; and certified registered nurse anesthetist

aprn_role_categories.quote: Advanced practice registered nurses shall include the following four (4) roles: certified nurse-midwife; clinical nurse specialist; certified nurse practitioner; and certified registered nurse anesthetist as defined in board rule.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: Functioning at the direction of a licensed registered nurse, licensed advanced practice registered nurse, licensed physician, or licensed dentist in a role falling within the nurse's scope of practice as defined by the board

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An APRN issued a multistate license is authorized to assume responsibility and accountability for patient care independent of a supervisory or collaborative relationship with a physician.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: Is registered as a nursing assistant, without substantiated charges, on the nursing assistant registry currently maintained by the Idaho department of health and welfare

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: The board shall issue a certificate of medication assistance (MA-C) to an individual who:

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A nurse with appropriate education, training, and experience and who is licensed under this chapter may delegate to a non-nurse tasks that do not involve the exercise of independent clinical judgment, as long as the nurse responsible for delegation maintains proper supervision and is satisfied that the person is qualified and adequately trained.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The terms and conditions of the nurse licensure compact are hereby enacted in substantially the following form

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The board may enter into agreements with peer assistance entities to undertake those functions and responsibilities specified in the agreements which assist the board in performing its duties, implementing disciplinary actions or sanctions, and in addressing potential or confirmed problems of chemical dependency and/or impairment

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: APRNs providing virtual care must act within their scope of practice; prescriptions may be issued via virtual care within scope and applicable laws, but controlled substances require compliance with federal law; treatment based solely on a static online questionnaire is not acceptable standard of care
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A provider delivering health care services via virtual care, including a prescription drug order or prescription medical device order, a provider shall obtain and document a patient's relevant clinical history and current symptoms to establish the diagnosis and identify underlying conditions and contraindications to the treatment recommended.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: The immunity from liability provided for in subsection (3) of this section applies regardless of whether a physician is physically present in the facility or practice setting where the CRNA is providing anesthesia services as long as the physician did not undertake, accept, or contractually agree to supervise or direct the CRNA's anesthesia care.
